MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Reproduction.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Ecology and Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Record keeping in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Record keeping in aquaculture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Record keeping in aquaculture.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Record keeping in aquaculture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Record keeping in aquaculture.

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of marine and freshwater environments? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fishery by- products and their industrial uses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Safety of Humans and Equipment in Marine Activities 4.2 Marine Operations and Se and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Maritime Operations and Seamanship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Marine Operations and Seamanship 4.3 Marine Resource Utilisation 4.4 Blue Econom and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
